label: Desert
description: Arid landforms as hero subjects — wind, flash floods and rare rain do all the carving.

items.name: star-dunes
items.text: a sea of star dunes raised by winds from three directions, sinuous arms radiating from every peak, crests knife-sharp between lit face and slip face

items.name: slot-canyon
items.text: a sandstone slot canyon barely a shoulder wide, walls spiraled smooth by flash floods, glowing orange with light bounced down from a sky it never shows

items.name: monument-buttes
items.text: monumental red buttes standing in haze-layered ranks, each one a mesa whittled down by the retreat of its own cliffs, talus cones aproned at every base

items.name: salt-flat-mirror
items.text: a salt flat flooded by rare winter rain into one seamless mirror, sky above and sky below meeting at an invisible horizon line

items.name: joshua-forest
items.text: a joshua tree woodland gesturing across pastel high-desert scrub, every branching arm ending in a spiked rosette, rounded granite boulder piles breaking the skyline

items.name: wave-rock
items.text: wind-polished sandstone swirled into candy bands — the crossbeds of fossil dunes frozen mid-migration and sliced open by erosion

items.name: desert-arch
items.text: a freestanding sandstone arch left standing where the soft heart of a rock fin fell away, framing hazed mesas through its span

items.name: cracked-playa
items.text: a dry lake bed tiled to the horizon with curling mudcrack polygons, one line of animal tracks stitched across the pale clay

items.name: palm-oasis
items.text: a spring-fed oasis pooled in a dune hollow, date palms ringing the water, the dune wall rising gold behind

items.name: gypsum-dunes
items.text: gypsum dunes so white they read as snowfields, a lone yucca casting the only shadow for miles

items.name: superbloom
items.text: an arid valley carpeted in a superbloom after winter rains, orange poppies running up the alluvial fans
